theorem: The E6 minuscule 27 is realized objectwise by the 27 complete two-qutrit factorisation frames.
Relative to one reference frame, Qpsi is 4 on the singlet frame, -2 on the ten frames sharing one factorisation, and 1 on the sixteen disjoint frames.
D12|F>=zeta12^{Qpsi(F)}|F> has exact order 12 and every one of the 45 tritangent cubics has phase product one.
On the formal 27-frame bundle direct_sum_F C^9, each block zeta12^{Qpsi(F)} I9 is an actual two-qutrit Clifford scalar because the scalar phase group is mu12.
firewall: A single scalar Clifford on one C9 cannot encode three distinct relative frame phases.
The theorem is a frame-bundle/controlled-phase carrier, not a bare one-C9 intertwiner.
A noncentral single-two-qutrit Clifford intertwiner remains open.
